_doc: Source list for scripts/fetch-audio.mjs. Network was blocked when this was written, so NOTHING here is verified.

I (audio-designer) do not reliably remember specific freesound sound IDs, so freesoundId is null everywhere instead of guessed IDs; each entry has a pre-filtered CC0 search URL. Pick a sound, put its numeric id in freesoundId.
With env FREESOUND_TOKEN set, fetch-audio asks the freesound API for the licence and refuses anything that is not CC0, then downloads the HQ OGG preview.
For opengameart/wikimedia/pack files set downloadUrl (direct file URL), author, sourceUrl, license, and verified:true after reading the licence on the source page.
Fields: trim{start,duration} seconds; edit{highpassHz,lowpassHz,fadeInMs,fadeOutMs,pitchSemitones?}; norm = target peak (0..1); sr = output sample rate; fetched is set by the script.
Once an entry is fetched, make-audio.mjs stops regenerating that key and the CREDITS.md line moves to the recorded table.
